entities.name: Notion
entities.how_described: 本集讲的平台:人和智能体共同思考的协作大脑,也是 Notion 自家 GTM 系统的上下文层——「我们在用 Notion 来发展 Notion」。

evidence.quote: I'm an engineer on the product growth team at Notion and now working on the GTM engineering team.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In case you don't know, Notion's platform is a collaborative brain for human and agents to think together.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Notion's business moves between self-serve growth and sales assist, and customers move between these two motions all the time.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Yes, our sales reps do use Notion for that, too.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Notion employees were actively using MCPs and their own agents to solve problems already, but they were innovating within their own departments.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So this data was normalized, and of course we brought it into Notion so that we could work with structured and unstructured data at the same time.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: They could use Notion itself, a tool they were already using, to explore context, investigate accounts, answer questions, and they could even take actions like sending to Nooks or sending to Outreach.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In a very literal sense, we are using Notion to grow Notion.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If there is a task for a sales rep, that actually just lands in their Notion database, and they can quickly view it and act on it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We can also use Notion custom agents, which are shareable across companies, to access this data context for recurring automated workflows.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So a new sales rep coming in, they can learn the Notion sales process, understand what signals are important to look for, understand which playbooks are effective, and basically know what good follow-up looks like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so, as I mentioned before, that context layer is a notion.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: For us, that layer is Notion.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: GTM
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:原本是营销运营问题,如今是最有趣的分布式系统问题之一;把营销/销售/客户运营的工具蛛网改造成 Know→Decide→Act→Learn 的单一决策系统。

evidence.quote: I'm an engineer on the product growth team at Notion and now working on the GTM engineering team.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A year ago, I would have told you that building a GTM system was a marketing ops problem.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: GTM at most companies involve a spider web of tools like what you see here, and they're stitched together by customer notes, proposals, contracts that are passed back and forth.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Over the last few months, a small team and myself, we've been trying to turn this spider web into a unified GTM system.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So what we found is that GTM had become a systems problem.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We ingest data from all the vendors in our GTM stack to Snowflake.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: First, our internal GTM teams didn't need to jump between many tools anymore.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What's interesting about the way we built our GTM systems is that if there is no signal about a customer, the marketing component of our system kicks in.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so Temporal lets us focus on writing the sequential logic for our GTM use cases while it will handle the retries, dedupes, and handling and going back to exactly where failures left off.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So this is what lets our engineers, agents, and GTM work off the same context.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Model GTM as primitives, entities, context, triggers, actions, eligibility rules, and the alien world becomes a system you can engineer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Right now, humans are the primary consumer of GTM data, and agents are helping at the edges.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体作为与人类同一系统里的「另一个操作者」运作:做大规模重复工作(收集上下文、调研、起草),人类提供判断并批准,不让智能体直接对客户说话。

evidence.quote: We found that instead of building an AI layer on top of our business, we designed our architecture so that the agent can operate as another operator within the same system as humans.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Firstly, we deliberately chose not to let an agent talk directly to a customer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so trust boundaries don't break down, especially because there is an agent in the middle.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We also persist agent-persisted or generated artifacts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And this task could be for a human or an agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And we shadowed our best reps to capture something that was the most repetitive part of our job and encoded it as a durable multi-agent workflow.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So an example of a cold outbound signal for us, we'll have a research sub-agent do concurrent web researches.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And then a review agent will pick the highest scoring one and make any updates if necessary.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The Gong transcript will come in, our agent will parse the transcript, and then, again, it will extract the critical sales med pick data, metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria, plan, and champion, and draft a grounded follow-up for that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Let's see how an agent and human work together in this shared customer view.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The rep can ask an agent, and the agent will reply querying our context layer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so if you encode a mediocre process, you get a mediocre agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 多智能体工作流 (multi-agent workflow)
entities.how_described: 本集说销售工作流被编码为 Temporal 上的持久多智能体工作流:研究子智能体并发调研→起草三封邮件打分→评审智能体挑优,循环改进后落入销售任务。

evidence.quote: And we shadowed our best reps to capture something that was the most repetitive part of our job and encoded it as a durable multi-agent workflow.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 上下文层 (context layer)
entities.how_described: 本集强调「只拥有上下文层,其余全租」:对客户理解最透彻、不能外包给通用工具,Notion 就是他们的上下文层,人和智能体从同一底座读取。

evidence.quote: Over the years, we've evolved into a context layer for your company, and AI agents can act on it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Know, a context layer we can trust about every customer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And last but not least, we decided that it was very important to own the context layer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The rep can ask an agent, and the agent will reply querying our context layer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We refuse to outsource the context layer because that's where our edge is.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A generic tool can't capture all of our esoteric data models or workflows, and we do not want that context layer to be something we can't debug.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so, as I mentioned before, that context layer is a notion.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 信号 (signal)
entities.how_described: 本集把信号定义为一个重要到足以改变客户下一步的单个事件(用户驱动或外部如融资、招聘),信号服务据此发出给人类或智能体的具体任务。

evidence.quote: We had one checker rule in an email tool, another in sales, and we pulled that all into one place so that these rules can be consumed across our code base, product, sales, engineering, and these are like customer segmentations or signal definitions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The unit here is a signal.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A signal is a single customer event that's important enough to change what should happen next for a customer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But some of them are not user-initiated at all, which are these external signal examples I listed here, like company raising funding, hiring signals, or shift in their tech stack.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So this is the signal service that watches the customer profile, decides whether a single action is available, decides who should own that action, and then it emits a concrete task following the architecture I described before.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What's interesting about the way we built our GTM systems is that if there is no signal about a customer, the marketing component of our system kicks in.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Every signal becomes a workflow on Temporal, which is something we rent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So an example of a cold outbound signal for us, we'll have a research sub-agent do concurrent web researches.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Temporal
entities.how_described: 本集说它是他们租用的工作流编排服务,处理重试、去重、断点续跑,让团队专注写顺序逻辑,单个格式错误的转录不会拖垮整批。

evidence.quote: Every signal becomes a workflow on Temporal, which is something we rent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so Temporal lets us focus on writing the sequential logic for our GTM use cases while it will handle the retries, dedupes, and handling and going back to exactly where failures left off.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
